proposition.claim:
A template \(T\) is a finite graph whose vertices are labelled full or empty. In \(T_\infty\), a vertex \(v\) is replaced by a countable blob \(W_v\), a clique if \(v\) is full and an independent set if \(v\) is empty. Edges between two blobs are complete or absent according to the corresponding edge of \(T\) [Retained latex: \cite[Section 3, PDF p.~9]{published}].
